points: RTX Spark: up to 128GB unified memory; laptops available 16 October, compact desktops in November
Microsoft Execution Containers generally available: agents run in the background under OS control
DGX Station for Windows in preview, 748GB memory; NVIDIA claims models of about a trillion parameters
take: Large models and always-on agents can now run on a laptop or desk machine, off the cloud meter. Worth testing for sensitive data; no prices given.
title: NVIDIA and Microsoft: Windows PCs built to run agents locally
